newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline prompt barge, swap values up $2.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline prompt barge, swap values up $2.

text.p: A quiet Thursday afternoon of gasoline barge activity followed an earlier period of trading that saw one confirmed and one rumored Eurograde balance-of-July trade at $199.
The trades, one of them involving a U.S. major selling to a Swiss-based trader, underlined a continuing prompt tightness and a $2 rise in values on the day.
The first half August barge market moved up by only $1, however, as a $195 trade was heard done.
August swaps also rose by around $2 as some of the market's attention was focused on mogas/naptha spread talk in the $9-$10 range.

Dealers also saw strong demand in the NWE and Med cargo markets amid limited avails, as a U.S. oil producer was seen offering a cargo on the north a formula-related basis and a trader was haerd bidding for an outstanding CIF Thames cargo.
